examples.arabic: لكن الحفيد الصغير فضل هاتفا جديدا من بائع مختلف
examples.english: But the young grandson preferred a new phone from a different seller.
examples.transliteration: Lakinna al-hafida as-saghir fadala hatifan jadidan min ba'i'in mukhtalifin.

examples.arabic: صرح ابن عمي الصغير عمر ان هذه اسعد لحظة في يومه
examples.english: My young cousin, Omar, declared that this was the happiest moment of his day.
examples.transliteration: Sarraha ibn 'ammi as-saghir 'Umar anna haathihi as'ad lahza fi yawmih.
